one_liner: Corporate card and finance automation platform with an API for transactions, users, and spend management.

auth.evidence_quote: To begin using the Ramp Developer API, you must first create a developer app to obtain your API credentials. Admin access is required.
auth.notes: OAuth2 with both client_credentials (server-to-server) and authorization_code (user-delegated) flows; separate sandbox and production environments exist.

access.notes: Existing Ramp customer admins can self-serve create a developer app and credentials; not confirmed whether a non-customer can get a standalone sandbox account.

api.notes: Docs pages returned JS-rendered shells during fetch; endpoint count and MCP status not confirmed within budget. Known from search snippet: base URL https://api.ramp.com/developer/v1, sandbox and production environments both exist.

verdict.rationale: Ramp customer admins can self-serve create OAuth2 developer apps with sandbox and production environments.
